title: Maximum Difference by Remapping a Digit
summary: Given an integer num, determine the difference between the maximum and minimum values that can be achieved by remapping exactly one digit in num to another digit.
statement: Given an integer num, determine the difference between the maximum and minimum values that can be achieved by remapping exactly one digit in num to another digit. When remapping a digit d1 to another digit d2, all occurrences of d1 in num are replaced with d2. Bob can remap a digit to itself, and the resulting number can contain leading zeroes.
constraints: For one remapping, choose a digit x and replace every occurrence of x by digit y.
Leading zeroes after remapping are allowed and simply disappear numerically.
Return the maximum obtainable number minus the minimum obtainable number, using independent remappings.
reference_solution:
def maximum_remap_difference(num):
    text=str(num);high_digit=next((char for char in text if char!='9'),None);low_digit=text[0]
    high=int(text.replace(high_digit,'9')) if high_digit else num
    low=int(text.replace(low_digit,'0'))
    return high-low

def maximum_remap_difference(num):
    text=str(num);high_digit=next((char for char in text if char!='9'),None);low_digit=text[-1]
    high=int(text.replace(high_digit,'9')) if high_digit else num
    low=int(text.replace(low_digit,'0'))
    return high-low
hints: To maximize, preserve leading nines and replace the first non-nine digit everywhere with nine.
To minimize, replace every occurrence of the leading digit with zero.
Compute the two remapped integers independently and subtract.
The earliest differing decimal position dominates all later positions, so both greedy digit choices are optimal.
editorial: The earliest differing decimal position dominates all later positions, so both greedy digit choices are optimal.

tests.explanation: Replacing one by nine gives 99899; replacing one by zero gives 890; their difference is 99009.
The maximum remains ninety while replacing nine by zero gives zero, so the difference is ninety.
